summary.one_liner: Peewee is a small, expressive Python ORM with a flexible query builder, supporting SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB and PostgreSQL, with optional asyncio support.
summary.what_it_does: Peewee lets you define database tables as Python model classes with typed fields and foreign keys, and create tables from them. It provides a composable query builder for selects, joins, filters, grouping, ordering, pagination, aggregates and atomic updates. It runs on SQLite (via the standard-library sqlite3 module), MySQL/MariaDB and PostgreSQL. Per the README, it is a single module with no required dependencies. An asyncio layer built on aiosqlite, asyncpg and aiomysql is included, with async save, create and query methods and server-side streaming. Schema migrations with diff-based generation are available through pwmigrate, and the README mentions many extensions.
use_cases: build a Flask or FastAPI web app backend
run async database queries with asyncio
use SQLite for a small local app
notable: Single-module ORM with no required dependencies, in production use since 2010
Query builder that exposes the full power of SQL, with composable expressions
Built-in asyncio support on standard async drivers, including server-side streaming iteration
Integrates with Flask, FastAPI and pydantic per the README
caveats: Backend drivers must be installed separately (e.g. peewee[mysql], peewee[postgres], peewee[asyncpg]); only SQLite is built in
Asyncio support requires the async driver extras and an async database class such as AsyncPostgresqlDatabase
